label: YAP1::MAMLD1

sections.text: YAP1 encodes a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 10413 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: MAMLD1 encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in developmental gene expression.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 10046 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: The fusion preserves YAP1 transcriptional coactivation in a persistently nuclear product that recruits TEAD and nuclear-factor-I factors. It drives the YAP1-fusion-positive ependymoma group, most often encountered in young children.

audit_evidence.location: Results, TEADs are required for YAP1-MAMLD1-driven tumorigenesis; Figure6a-e; NFIs are essential for fusion-driven hyperproliferation
audit_evidence.scope: TEAD-binding mutation prevents tumors; nuclear fusion and NFI requirement documented.

report_comment.text: YAP1 encodes a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling. MAMLD1 encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in developmental gene expression. The fusion preserves YAP1 transcriptional coactivation in a persistently nuclear product that recruits TEAD and nuclear-factor-I factors. It drives the YAP1-fusion-positive ependymoma group, most often encountered in young children.
